name: app-dark-navy-nft-marketplace-two-tilted-phones-with-lavender-accents
title: Navy NFT Marketplace Tilted Phones
whatItIs: Two tilted navy phones on white: an onboarding with a pink sculptural portrait in an oval and the headline 'Discover, Collect And Sell NFTS' over a lavender wave, and an Explore the Rare NFTs screen with tabs and a stacked card holding a monkey avatar with a bid price.
whatItMeans: Dark screens with a pink 3D figure and lavender highlights feel premium and artful, and tilting adds motion.
techniques: Pink sculpture in an oval as the onboarding hero
Stacked offset cards behind the featured NFT
Lavender used for highlighted words and the wave
Frosted price chip over the artwork
bestFor: Dark UI with a single soft accent

vocabulary.definition: Offset layers peeking behind the main card.
A photo cropped into an ellipse.
A small label showing the current price.
